agent: occupation and revolt wave, reader B (revolt risk and what it does)
question: Revolt risk's daily step, its effective figure, the units of CProvince +0x28 and +0x328 against the saves, the setter and its callers, CProvince +0x60/+0x64 and the full revolt with CSpawnFullRevoltCommand, the five conditions, and what the player is shown of revolt risk.

addresses.name: RunDailyProvincePass
addresses.comment: **The daily pass over one province**, read end to end on the listing (0x49EAB0 to the single `ret 4` at 0x49F240). Called once per province from a plain serial loop inside RunDailyPass at 0x682E4B, on the game thread, at the day's turn - the controller entries it files carry hour 0 (the 20 April 1936 save's `1936.3.5.0`). **Nothing at all is done to a province whose template is not `simulated` (+0x13D)**, the revolt-risk floor included. In order: (1) ComputeProvinceClimate (0x4A81A0). (2) roads = infrastructure x (1000 + local + global infrastructure) / 1000 (province modifiers 12, 13, 14), held between floorf(10.5) and 1000; rate = (100 + roads) x (1000 + the controller's `repair_rate`, CTechnologyStatus +0xC4) / 1000; each of the seven goods of `current_producing` rises by the rate to `max_producing`, and each building whose definition says `repair` (+0xDE) by BUILDING_REPAIR_SPEED x the rate to its maximum, its dirty byte (+0x28) set when it moved. **The local flag at [ebp+0xB] is set when one of those repairs carried a building across a whole level** (floor(new/1000) > floor(old/1000)). (3) `capital` (+0x2B0) = 1 where the controller's acting capital (+0xE24) is this province or across one of its template's edges, else 0. (4) suppression (+0x28) = SuppressionNearProvince. (5) **RebuildProvinceModifierValues (0x49F3E0) only when the flag is set**, so the revolt step reads the modifier values of the last rebuild unless a building came back today. (6) **Revolt risk (+0x328), 0x49EE0F..0x49EED6**: when the owner is not the controller (`owner_id (+0x330) != controller->id`) and the controller is at war with the owner (the inlined IsEnemyTag: `controller->statuses (+0xE28)[owner_id]->war (+0x20)` non-null, or either tag REB): cap = values[MODIFIER_LOCAL_PARTISAN_SUPPORT] ([[p+0x114]+0x260]); step = +100, or -100 when the risk is already above the cap; cut = min(suppression x 100 / 1000 (64-bit, truncated), 200); risk += step - cut; if risk > cap then risk = cap. Then, on every simulated province, risk = max(risk, 0). The 100 and 200 are the generic fixed-point globals 0x1A86CF4 and 0x1A86CD0. (7) CProvince::UpdateSupplyDepot (0x4A70C0). (8) **The on_encirclement on_action** when out_of_supply_days (+0x20) is exactly 1, the area's slot 0 answers true and area +0x68 is set: one inlined MT19937 draw seeds a stack CEventScope on the province (country '---'), and the on_action is looked up (0x9C8830), its event picked (0x9C7E10) and fired (0x9C0C80) - not an 'out-of-supply draw', as this comment said. (9) **The day's return of occupied land**: when owner and controller differ, the owner is not at war with the controller (`owner->statuses[controller_id]->war` null), neither tag is REB and the owner is not a government in exile (+0x95), Province_SetController(province, &owner_tag, &now, true, true, false). (10) A province with no owner (owner_id 0) and a controller gets Province_SetController(province, '---', &now, false, false, false). (11) On land (template +0x22) each of the seven goods of `pool` held between the fixed-point zero (0x1A87818) and 99999.000. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-occupation.md, section B.1; reversing/findings/FINDINGS-supplyconvoys.md, section 8, for the bounds; reversing/findings/FINDINGS-bombing.md, section 11.
addresses.revises: Comment only, signature kept. The step order is now complete and placed: the rebuild flag is named (a repairing building crossing a whole level), the revolt-risk block is given exactly, the '+0x20 == 1 out-of-supply draw' is corrected to the on_encirclement on_action (as FINDINGS-revolt.md section 1.3 had already said), and the two Province_SetController calls that end the pass - the return of occupied land and the clearing of an ownerless province's controller - are added; the old comment left them out.
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0x49EAB0..0x49F240 on the listing in one piece: gate je 0x49F230 at 0x49EADF; flag writes at 0x49ECCF (0) and 0x49ED62 (1) under `cmp byte [edx+0xde],0` and the floor-difference test at 0x49ED3A..0x49ED60; rebuild call 0x49EE0A behind `cmp byte [ebp+0xb],0; je`; the revolt block 0x49EE0F..0x49EED6 instruction for instruction; 'on_encirclement' pushed at 0x49F036 under `cmp [ebx+0x20],1` at 0x49EF65; Province_SetController (rva 0xA2400, recorded) at 0x49F1C5 and 0x49F1F0 with their pushes; the pool clamp loop 0x49F210..0x49F22E. addresses.name: GetProvinceEffectiveRevoltRisk
addresses.comment: **The effective revolt risk**, thousandths of a percentage point, 0x4A4050 to the bare `ret` at 0x4A40D6: *out = 0; the accumulated +0x328 only when CCountry::IsEnemyTag(controller, &owner_tag) (0x42F1B0) - the controller at war with the owner, or either REB; plus countryValues[MODIFIER_GLOBAL_REVOLT_RISK] ([[c+0xDA8]+0x10], modifier 2) of the **owner** when the controller is REB and of the controller otherwise, skipped when controller_id (+0x338) is 0; plus provinceValues[MODIFIER_LOCAL_REVOLT_RISK] ([[p+0x114]+0x8], modifier 1); minus suppression (+0x28). Returns out in EAX. **Province in EDI, out in ESI, nothing on the stack**: the `push eax; push ecx` inside are its own - the second is dropped by `add esp,4` and the first is IsEnemyTag's argument - so the frame is balanced and no caller pushes anything. **It does not apply the MINIMUM_REVOLT_RISK floor**; every reader but CPureRevoltRiskTrigger does it afterwards as max(this, max(values[0], 0)). Twenty call sites: the revolt_risk static modifier (0x4A0520, 0x4A05C1), the roll 0x4C07C0, the alert pass (0x6044FE, 0x60454E, 0x6045AE) and its comparator (four), the province view (0x6E0390, 0x6E03F8), the revolt map mode (four), the two triggers, and two AI readers (0x8B9D46, 0x8E1AA6). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-occupation.md, section B.1.
addresses.revises: The comment said 'one dword pushed and left for the caller'; it is wrong - the function pushes two dwords of its own and pops both, takes nothing on the stack, and every caller (0x9E7644, 0x6044FE, 0x60123F) calls it with only EDI and ESI set. The signature is rewritten from the /*edi*/ comment form into the record's register convention (@EDI, @ESI, result @EAX) so checkSignatures can read it; the arithmetic is unchanged and re-read.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x4A4050..0x4A40D6: `push ebx; lea eax,[edi+0x32c]; push eax; push ecx; lea ecx,[edi+0x334]; mov [esi],0; call 0x402610; add esp,4; mov ecx,eax; call 0x42f1b0` (IsEnemyTag, ret 4, consumes the pushed &owner_tag) ... `pop ebx; add [esi],eax; mov eax,esi; ret`. Callers checked at 0x9E7641 (`lea esi,[ebp+8]` then the call, no push) and 0x6044FA. What would show it wrong: a caller that adjusts esp after the call.

addresses.name: SetProvinceRevoltRisk
addresses.signature: void __stdcall SetProvinceRevoltRisk(CProvince* province, int value, bool logHistory)
addresses.comment: **Sets** a province's accumulated revolt risk: +0x328 = max(value, 0) (0x4A411A..0x4A4120). **The bool is not an announcement**: when it is set, a 0x18-byte CRevoltRiskChange is built for the province (CRevoltRiskChange::CRevoltRiskChange, 0x5FE2D0), given the new figure through `floor((risk / 1000.0 + 0.0005) x 1000)` (single precision, CRevoltRiskChange::SetValue 0x5FE270), dated now (`+8 = gamestate tick (+0xBDC)`) and filed in the province's history (`province->history (+0xD8)` slot 6, CHistoryContainer::AddEntry) - so it is saved as a dated `revolt_risk = N` line in the province's `history` block. No message, no text, no player told. ret 0xC. Four callers: CreateRebelBrigadesInProvince (0x4C1301, (province, 0, false) - rebels made reset it), CRevoltRiskChange::Apply forward (0x5FE3EB, (province, the entry's value, false)) and backward (0x5FE410, (province, the value it replaced, false)), and CRevoltRiskEffect::Execute (0x9A55E3, (province, risk + value, true) - the script effect `revolt_risk = N`). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-occupation.md, section B.3.
addresses.revises: The third argument is renamed from `announce` to `logHistory`: what it does is file a CRevoltRiskChange in the province's history, not report anything, and the comment's 'reports the change' is replaced. A signature is added (the record had none), and the four callers are now each identified - 0x5FE3EB and 0x5FE410 are CRevoltRiskChange::Apply, 0x9A55E3 CRevoltRiskEffect::Execute.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x4A40F0..0x4A4244 (`ret 0xc`): the store and floor at 0x4A411A/0x4A4120; `cmp byte [ebp+0x10],bl; je 0x4a4234` gates `push 0x18; call operator new; push edi; mov ecx,eax; call 0x5fe2d0`, the float arithmetic with the doubles 1000.0 (0x160A300) and 0.0005 (0x160A460), `call 0x5fe270`, `mov [edi+8], gamestate+0xBDC`, then `[province+0xD8]` slot 6 (`call [eax+0x18]`) with the entry. 0x5FE270 is `this->+0x10 = arg; ret 4`. CHistoryContainer::AddEntry is recorded as slot 6 of every history container. What would show it wrong: a reader of the history entry that posts a message.

addresses.name: SuppressionInProvince
addresses.signature: int* SuppressionInProvince(/*eax*/ CMapProvince* province, int* out)
addresses.comment: The suppression the units standing in one province deliver, 0x49F250 to the `ret 4` at 0x49F35B; province in EAX, the out int* the one stack argument. *out = 0; for each unit of the province's units (+0x2B8) whose owner is on the controller's side (CountryOf(unit->+0x124)->0x4EF7C0(&province->controller_tag, true)): strength = the sum of its regiments' +0x5C over the list at +0x38; max = virtual slot 23 (GetMaxStrength, by out pointer); ratio = strength x 1000 / max (32-bit while strength is small enough, else the __allmul/__alldiv pair; -1 when max is 0); *out += ratio x definition->suppression (CUnit +0xC8, CSubUnitDefinition +0x130) / 1000, truncated. Then *out = *out x 1000 / 10000, truncated - **the /10 is per province**, before any sum across provinces. **The definition at +0xC8 is the division's own, built by CUnit::RebuildDefinition as the sum of its brigades' definitions**, so a division's suppression is its brigades' total: three militia (0.33) are 990, two infantry (1.00) 2000, a corps HQ (0.67) 670 - all confirmed against a save (reversing/findings/FINDINGS-occupation.md, section B.2). So a brigade with suppression 1.00 at full strength puts 0.100 into the province's figure.
addresses.revises: Comment only, signature kept. The old comment said '**Suppression comes from the unit's own definition, not summed over its brigades**', which FINDINGS-occupation.md section 1.3 had already corrected in prose: +0xC8 is the division's summed definition. It is now also settled by the save - with one brigade's suppression in place of the division's sum the 8 January 1936 prediction for province 9987 is 0.071, with the sum it is 0.031, and the save says 0.031. The per-province placement of the /10 and the max-strength-zero arm are added.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x49F250..0x49F35B: `mov ecx,[edi+0xc8]; mov edx,[ecx+0x130]`; the regiment walk `add esi,[ecx+0x5c]` over [edi+0x38]; `call [edx+0x5c]` (slot 23) with an out pointer; `or eax,-1` when it answers 0; `imul [ebp-8]` then __alldiv by 0x3E8; after the loop __allmul by 0x3E8 and __alldiv by 0x2710. The save test is in the findings section; a different suppression scale or no per-province /10 does not give 0.031.

addresses.name: SuppressionNearProvince
addresses.signature: int* SuppressionNearProvince(/*edi*/ CMapProvince* province, int* out)
addresses.comment: CProvince +0x28's whole figure, 0x49F360 to the `ret 4` at 0x49F3D0; province in EDI, the out int* the one stack argument. *out = SuppressionInProvince(province), then for every province of `near_provinces` (+0x14C..+0x150) that is land (template +0x22) and has the same controller id (+0x338), *out += SuppressionInProvince(it). **`near_provinces` is every province within two edges and the province itself**, so **a province's own units count twice** and every same-controller land province two edges out counts once. Its only caller is the daily province pass, which stores the result in +0x28. Checked against the save: for province 9987 on 7 January 1936 22:00 this gives 692 - its own militia division twice (98 + 98), the 2-edge cluster's 9995 (331), 10003 (98) and a corps HQ at 10022, two edges out (67) - and the step 0.1 - 0.069 = 0.031 is the save's figure for the next day. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-occupation.md, section B.2.
addresses.revises: Comment only, signature kept. It said 'every province in its adjacency vector' and 'one garrison suppresses a cluster' of adjacent provinces. The vector is the two-edge `near_provinces` list (as the record's own CMapProvince +0x14C says), which contains the province itself - so the province's own units are counted twice and provinces two edges away count too. The save settles it: with neighbours only the 8 January prediction is 0.048, with the two-edge list without the double count 0.041, with both 0.031, the save's figure.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x49F360..0x49F3D0: `call 0x49f250` on the province first, then the loop over [edi+0x14C]..[edi+0x150] with `cmp byte [edx+0x22],0` and `cmp ecx,[edi+0x338]` before each `call 0x49f250`. CMapProvince +0x14C is recorded as 'every province within two edges ... and so the province itself'. The save prediction, scripts in the findings section, uses tfh/map/provinces.bmp adjacency, tfh/units suppression and max_strength, and Germany1936_01_07_22.hoi3's units and controllers; it lands on the save's 0.031 and every alternative reading misses it.

addresses.name: SpawnFullRevoltInProvince
addresses.comment: **A province history's `revolt = { type size }`, carried out when a new game is entered.** One caller, 0x65BF81 in CInGameIdler::Enter's per-province pass, which runs only for a session **not** loaded from a save (`loaded_from_save (+0xD9C)` set skips it) and calls RebuildProvinceModifierValues immediately before. Read whole (0x4A6C30 to the bare `ret` at 0x4A6E37): (1) **when the accumulated revolt risk (+0x328) is 0 it is set to values[MODIFIER_LOCAL_PARTISAN_SUPPORT]** - for every province of a new game, before the next test; (2) return when +0x60 (the rebel type) is null; (3) brigades = +0x64 x max(1, manpower (+0x320) / 1000), the division truncating; (4) faction = FindRebelFactionForProvince(gamestate@EAX, province, type); with one, CreateRebelsForFaction(faction, ..., province, brigades, 0) with a '---' tag; without, 0x686D80 makes a faction of the type with the brigades; (5) when there is a faction and the province's controller is REB, RebelFaction_TakeProvince(faction, province->id). +0x60/+0x64 are written by SetProvinceRevolt (0x4A6E40) from CRevoltChange::Apply - a province history's dated `revolt` entry replayed to the start date. No file of Their Finest Hour or BlackICE has one, so in those the pass only does step (1). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-occupation.md, section B.4.
addresses.revises: Raised from likely to confirmed, and the account of who calls it corrected: it is **not** CSpawnFullRevoltCommand::Execute (that command mobilises an exile's undergrounds through 0x50B1E0 and never reaches here), and the caller is CInGameIdler::Enter's new-game province pass rather than 'the in-game screen path'. Where +0x60/+0x64 come from is now known (the province history's `revolt` key), the always-taken step (1) is made explicit, and the REB tail RebelFaction_TakeProvince is added.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x4A6C30..0x4A6E37 read whole; findRefs --callers 0x4A6C30 gives the one site 0x65BF81, inside CInGameIdler::Enter (rva 0x25A2B0, recorded) after `cmp byte [ecx+0xd9c],0; jne 0x65c00a` at 0x65BF47 and `call 0x49f3e0` at 0x65BF7A. CSpawnFullRevoltCommand's slot 6 (0x55C6A0) calls 0x50B1E0 and nothing else. What would show it wrong: a second caller of 0x4A6C30 (the brute-force E8 scan finds one).

addresses.name: SetProvinceRevolt
addresses.no_signature: A register convention with two by-value std::strings: province in EAX, the CRebelType* in ECX, then on the stack the size (int, +8), the name (a 0x1C-byte Hoi3CString by value, +0xC) and the leader (another, +0x28); `ret 0x3C` cleans 4 + 0x1C + 0x1C. The record's signature syntax has no by-value string slot, so none is written rather than one that misplaces the leader.
addresses.comment: Writes a province's revolt: +0x60 = the rebel type, +0x64 = the size, then **frees the name and the leader without storing them** - so a history `revolt`'s `name` and `leader` are read and thrown away. 0x4A6E40 to the `ret 0x3C` at 0x4A6E80, no frame beyond ebp. One caller found, CRevoltChange::Apply (0x5FFDDA forward, 0x5FFE3A backward). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-occupation.md, section B.4.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x4A6E40..0x4A6E80: `mov [eax+0x60],ecx; mov [eax+0x64],[ebp+8]`, two capacity tests ([ebp+0x20], [ebp+0x3C] >= 0x10) each freeing its buffer, `ret 0x3c`. CRevoltChange::Apply sets EAX to the province (+0xC), ECX to +0x10 or +0x50 and pushes +0x14 or +0x54 after two 0x1C-byte string copies. What would show it wrong: a read of the two strings inside, which there is none of.

addresses.name: BuildProvinceRevoltRiskTooltip
addresses.comment:
**The tooltip of the province view's revolt-risk figure (`text_partisans`).** 0x4A4250 to the `ret 8` at 0x4A5069 (an early `ret 8` at 0x4A435B is the fog arm). When Province_IsHiddenByFog: `CANT_SEE_UNDER_FOW` alone. Otherwise, lines in this order: (1) `LIKELY_REBELS` + ': \xA7Y' + the `<type>_title` text of ChooseRebelTypeForProvince(db, province, false, '---') + '\xA7W
', only when a type is chosen; (2) `PARTISAN_SUPPORT` + ': \xA7R+' + FormatFixedPoint(+0x328, 2) + '\xA7W
', only when +0x328 > 0 and the controller IsEnemyTag the owner - **the accumulator, not the effective figure**; (3) CModifier::DescribeContributors(kind 2 GLOBAL_REVOLT_RISK, scale 1000) of the global modifier (+0xD90) of the owner when the controller is REB, else of the controller, trimmed, then '
'; (4) the province's own modifier (+0xFC) DescribeContributors(kind 1 LOCAL_REVOLT_RISK, 1000), trimmed, '
'; (5) `SUPPRESSION` + ': \xA7G-' + FormatFixedPoint(+0x28, 2) + '\xA7W
', only when +0x28 is not 0; (6) always, the localised name of modifier 0 (MINIMUM_REVOLT_RISK) + ': \xA7Y' + FormatFixedPoint(values[0], 2) + '%\xA7W
'. The whole trimmed into out. FormatFixedPoint truncates. One caller, BuildProvinceViewTooltip at 0x6E678D, for the element `text_partisans`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-occupation.md, section B.6.

The colour strings read out of .rdata: 0x15B6B88 '\xA7W\n', 0x15BEAA4 ': \xA7Y', 0x15BE9C0 ': \xA7R+', 0x15BEACC ': \xA7G-', 0x15B5E34 '%\xA7W\n'. findRefs --callers 0x4A4250 gives one site. What would show it wrong: a second caller, or a line order the append calls do not follow.

addresses.name: Province_IsHiddenByFog
addresses.comment: False when fog of war is off (g_FogOfWarEnabled, 0x170AD30, clear); otherwise true when the local player's knowledge of the province is below 2: `province->intel_by_country_ptr (+0x370)[gamestate->+0xC34] < 2` (cmp/sbb/neg). 0x4A5070 to the `ret 4` at 0x4A513D, with the game-state accessor inlined. Gates the revolt-risk tooltip to CANT_SEE_UNDER_FOW. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-occupation.md, section B.6.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x4A5070..0x4A513D: `cmp byte [0x170ad30],bl; jne` else `xor al,al`; `mov eax,[esi+0xc34]; mov edx,[ecx+0x370]; cmp byte [eax+edx],2; sbb eax,eax; neg eax`. +0xC34 is the player's country id in three recorded comments. What would show it wrong: a caller reading it as the opposite sense - BuildProvinceRevoltRiskTooltip takes the FOW arm on true.

addresses.name: MapMode_Revolt_ColourLoop
addresses.comment: **Colours every province for the revolt-risk map mode** (mode 12, button `mapmode_5`). 0x865C40 to the `ret 4` at 0x8660DD; for provinces 1 .. count-1 of the object list, both colours (+0 and +4 of the province object) get the same packed colour. b = 1.0 where the map's player (CMap +0x2A8C) knows the province at 2 or more (+0x370), else 0.5, and 0 for a province not `simulated`; grey = (0.9b, 0.9b, 0.9b) is the default. **Only a province the player controls, or knows at 3 or more, is coloured by risk**, r = max(GetProvinceEffectiveRevoltRisk, max(values[0], 0)): above 4000 (4 points) red (f x b, 0.3b, 0.3b) with f = min(1.0, 0.7 + 0.3 x (r / 1000) / 15); from 2000 orange (0.9b, 0.6b, 0.3b); above 0 yellow (0.9b, 0.9b, 0.3b); at 0 a flat green (0.3, 0.9, 0.3) not scaled by b. Then, for those same provinces, **an underground (+0x30C level_max (+0x20) above 0) overrides it with red (b, 0.3b, 0.3b)**. One caller, MapMode_Revolt_Set. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-occupation.md, section B.6.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x865C40..0x8660DD read whole; constants read out of .rdata: 1.0 (0x171DBAC), 0.5 (0x15AB304), 0.9 (0x160A568, 0x160A678), 15.0 (0x160A6E8), 0.3 (0x160A3E8, 0x15C05EC), 0.7 (0x160A5D0), 0.6 (0x160A560); the thresholds `cmp ecx,0xfa0; jle`, `cmp ecx,0x7d0; jl`, `test ecx,ecx; jle`; the underground test `mov ecx,[edi+0x30c]; cmp [ecx+0x20],0; jle`; the stores `mov [edx],eax` and `mov [edx+4],eax` at 0x8660C2/0x8660CB. findRefs --callers gives the single site 0x6665E3.

addresses.name: MapMode_Revolt_Set
addresses.comment: **The revolt-risk map mode's setter** (map mode 12). Unless the mode is already 12, the `click` sound (when the sound's slot 25 allows); the air and naval icons down when leaving 18 or 19; the idler's +0xD34 and CMap +0x2A90 = 12; settings +0xE7 = 0, the layer mask +0xF0 = 0xFFBE, the map style +0xF4 = 2; the graphics owner's +0x60F8 = 0; 0x863EC0; MapMode_Revolt_ColourLoop on the graphics owner's +0x1DC4; 0x880D90; MapMode_ShowButton(5) - the button `mapmode_5`, sprite GFX_mapmode_revolt, whose tooltip is MAPMODE_5 'Revoltrisk Mapmode'; the graphics owner's +0x60DC = 1. Bare `ret`. Reached only through the in-game idler's button table (its address is stored at 0x647DEA into the slot at +0xDD8). The map tooltip has nothing of its own for mode 12: ProvinceTooltip_ModeJumpTable entry 12 is the shared tail 0x49CBAE. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-occupation.md, section B.6.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x666430..0x666630: `cmp dword [ebx+0xd34],0xc; je` at 0x666451, 'click' at 0x666464, `mov eax,0xc` stored to +0xD34 and [0x1A8557C]+0x2A90 at 0x66658A..0x666595, the three settings stores, `call 0x865c40` at 0x6665E3, `push 5; call 0x665980` (MapMode_ShowButton, recorded) at 0x666606. menubar.gui gives `mapmode_5` the sprite GFX_mapmode_revolt; CInGameIdler::GetElementTooltip answers `mapmode_N` with MAPMODE_N (recorded). addresses.name: AlertPass_RevoltRiskList
addresses.comment: **The revolt-risk alert (alert 3, `alert_revoltrisk_in_provinces`) is built and never shown.** In CAlertManager_Update, over the played country's ControlledProvinces (+0xD00): every province with r = max(effective, max(values[0], 0)) > 0 goes into the manager's list (+0xA10), and a hash adds the province id x1 (r below 1000), x13 (below 4000) or x17; when the hash differs from the last (0x1BEA444) the list is sorted with CompareProvincesByRevoltRisk. Then **when alert 3 is up (+0x1C4) it is hidden** (0x608730, eax 3) - and nothing shows it: the fifteen calls of CAlertManager_Show (0x607FE0) push 0, 1, 2 and 4 to 15, never 3. So `alert_revoltrisk_in_provinces_instant` ('\xA7YPossible Partisans\xA7W') and `_delayed` ('The following provinces run a risk of having a partisan uprising.\n$LIST$') are registered (CAlertManager_Register with 3, at 0x6016DB) and never appear. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-occupation.md, section B.6.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x6044C9..0x60467B: the +0xD00 walk, three GetProvinceEffectiveRevoltRisk calls, `cmp ecx,0x3e8`, `cmp ecx,0xfa0`, `imul eax,eax,0xd` and `shl ecx,4; add ...; add ecx,eax` (x17), qsort at 0x60465D, `cmp [esi+0x1c4],ebx; je; mov eax,3; call 0x608730`. The fifteen callers of 0x607FE0 each read for their pushed index (positive control: indices 0-2 and 4-15 are all found, so the method sees pushes); findRefs --address 0x607FE0 finds no non-call reference. The only refresh path naming 3 is inside CAlertManager_Show itself (0x608349). What would show it wrong: an indirect call to 0x607FE0 with 3.

addresses.name: RebuildNeighbours_CountRebelHeldProvince
addresses.comment: `inc dword ptr [ebx + 0xF50]` - **what `num_of_revolts` counts**: CCountry::RebuildNeighbours zeroes provinces_in_revolt (+0xF50) and +0xF54 (0x4E2317, 0x4E231D) and then, walking the country's OwnedProvinces (+0xCF0), adds one to each for every province whose **controller tag is REB** (0x4E29EA..0x4E2A26). Callers of 0x4E21E0 by the E8 scan: 65, including 0x68F065 in ProcessCountriesPreDailyUpdate_start_for::execute and 0x4A2110 in CMapProvince::TakeControl.

addresses.name: CSpawnFullRevoltCommand::Execute
addresses.comment: **'Organized Revolt!' is not a full revolt.** Slot 6, the whole body: CCountry_MobilizeAllUndergrounds (0x50B1E0, read by brief E and agreeing)(countries[this->+0x40]) - the country the command names (+0x3C tag, +0x40 id). 0x50B1E0 walks that country's underground list (+0xD60) and, for each province it **owns** whose underground's level_current (+0x24) is **above** SPAWN_PARTISAN_LIMIT, builds a CSpawnPartisanCommand for the province on the stack and runs its slot 14 (IsValid) and, when that passes, its slot 6 (Execute) in place - partisans from every ready underground at once. It never reaches SpawnFullRevoltInProvince. Bare `ret`. Posted only by CPoliticsView::OnRevolt (the exile's `revolt` button) for the played country; valid only for a government in exile (IsValid, slot 14). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-occupation.md, section B.4.

structs.comment: The base of every entry of a province's history (`CProvince +0xD8`): the province at +0xC. Its constructor is 0x1FDE10.

structs.name: CRevoltRiskChange
structs.comment: A province history's `revolt_risk = N`: +0x10 the figure set, +0x14 the figure it replaced. Filed by SetProvinceRevoltRisk when its logHistory flag is set, and by the history loader.
structs.evidence: Both allocations are `operator new(0x18)` (0x4A412B, 0x5FD217); RTTI base CProvinceHistoryEntry at 0, table 0x15CA220.

structs.name: CRevoltChange
structs.comment: A province history's `revolt = { type size name leader }`: what Apply hands SetProvinceRevolt, and the province's previous +0x60/+0x64 for going back.
structs.evidence: The history loader allocates it with `push 0x90; call operator new` at 0x5FD5CC and constructs it with 0x5FFBA0; RTTI base CProvinceHistoryEntry at 0, table 0x15CA244. The loader stores `type` at +0x10, `name` at +0x18, `leader` at +0x34, `size` at +0x14 (CRevoltChange::LoadKey, 0x5FFE50).

struct_fields.name: province
struct_fields.comment: The province whose history holds the entry; every Apply acts on it.
struct_fields.evidence: Written by the constructor 0x5FDE10 from its one argument; read as the province by CRevoltRiskChange::Apply (0x5FE384) and CRevoltChange::Apply (0x5FFD4E).

struct_fields.name: value

struct_fields.evidence: SetValue (0x5FE270) writes it; Apply passes it to SetProvinceRevoltRisk; SaveContents writes it under token 0x207.

struct_fields.name: previous

struct_fields.evidence: CRevoltRiskChange::Apply stores raw/1000*1000 here at 0x5FE3C8 and passes it to SetProvinceRevoltRisk on the backward arm.

struct_fields.name: type

struct_fields.name: previous_type
struct_fields.comment: The province's +0x60 before Apply went forward.
struct_fields.evidence: CRevoltChange::Apply 0x5FFD57..0x5FFD63 copies province +0x60 here; the backward arm hands it back.

struct_fields.name: previous_size

struct_fields.name: suppression
struct_fields.comment: How much suppression stands in and around this province, thousandths. Recomputed every day by the daily province pass (0x49EE04) from SuppressionNearProvince (rva 0x9F360): the province's own figure plus that of every land province within two edges under the same controller - and the province's own a second time, since it is in its own two-edge list. A province's figure is the sum over its friendly units of strength/max_strength times the division's suppression (the sum of its brigades'), divided by 10 - so a full-strength brigade with suppression 1.00 contributes 0.100, and 1.000 here (ten such brigades' worth) stops the daily climb. Two readers on a tick: the daily revolt-risk step subtracts min(this x 0.1, 0.2) from its plus-or-minus 0.1, and GetProvinceEffectiveRevoltRisk subtracts this outright, a full point per 1.000. Checked against a save to the thousandth (reversing/findings/FINDINGS-occupation.md, section B.2).
struct_fields.revises: Comment only. It said 'over this province and every adjacent land province' and 'a brigade with suppression = 2.0 at full strength contributes 200'; the list is the two-edge one including the province itself (counted twice), and the 200 (0.200) for a 2.0 brigade stands - the units are now settled against Germany1936_01_08_02.hoi3 instead of resting on the loader.
struct_fields.evidence: SuppressionNearProvince read on the listing (0x49F360..0x49F3D0) and the save prediction for province 9987 (0.031 predicted and saved).

struct_fields.name: rebel_type_ptr
struct_fields.comment: The rebel type of a province history's `revolt = { type ... }`, or null. Written only by SetProvinceRevolt (rva 0xA6E40), from CRevoltChange::Apply when the history is replayed (and zeroed by 0x496AB1, 0x40DE92). Read by SpawnFullRevoltInProvince (rva 0xA6C30) when a new game is entered, which does nothing more for a province where it is null. **Not saved**. No province file of Their Finest Hour or BlackICE has a `revolt`, so it is null in both.
struct_fields.revises: Type void* -> CRebelType* (the history loader resolves it through the rebel type database), and the comment's 'what sets it at runtime is not established' is answered: SetProvinceRevolt from the province history's `revolt` entry.
struct_fields.evidence: SetProvinceRevolt `mov [eax+0x60],ecx` at 0x4A6E4A with ECX = CRevoltChange +0x10, which LoadKey fills from GetRebelTypeDatabase/0x4C0420.

struct_fields.name: rebel_brigades_per_manpower
struct_fields.comment: The `size` of a province history's `revolt`: SpawnFullRevoltInProvince (rva 0xA6C30) makes this times max(1, manpower(+0x320)/1000) rebel brigades. Written by SetProvinceRevolt (rva 0xA6E40) from CRevoltChange::Apply; not saved, and zeroed by the same two writers as +0x60.
struct_fields.revises: Comment only: the writer (SetProvinceRevolt, from the history's `revolt` `size`) is now known.

struct_fields.name: provinces_in_revolt
struct_fields.comment: **How many provinces the country owns that rebels hold**: CCountry::RebuildNeighbours zeroes it and adds one for each province of OwnedProvinces (+0xCF0) whose controller tag is REB (0x4E2A05), recounting it daily and at every change of hands. Read by `num_of_revolts` (CNumOfRevoltsTrigger::Evaluate, 0x5D73D0, `>=` a raw count) and as the numerator of `revolt_percentage` over NumberOfOwnedProvinces (+0xCF8) (CNumOfRevoltsFractionTrigger, 0x5D7950); FINDINGS-aiconsumer.md's AI slot 73 tests it `> 0`. +0xF54 is counted identically and never read.
struct_fields.revises: Comment only: what is counted is now read off its one writer (provinces owned and REB-controlled), where the old comment inferred 'provinces in revolt' from the two triggers.
struct_fields.evidence: A whole-.text displacement scan for 0xF50: three writes (0x4D42A4, 0x4E2317, 0x4E2A05) and the two known trigger reads (positive control).

struct_fields.name: provinces_in_revolt_unread
struct_fields.comment: Counted exactly like provinces_in_revolt (+0xF50) - the same REB-controller test over OwnedProvinces, in CCountry::RebuildNeighbours (0x4E2A26) - and zeroed with it (0x4E231D, CCountry_Reset 0x4D42AA). **No reader anywhere in .text**: a dead duplicate.
struct_fields.evidence: A whole-.text displacement scan for 0xF54 (chunks between int3 runs decoded from their own starts, capstone resumed past every stop) finds the three writes and nothing else outside stack frames; the same scan for 0xF50 finds both of +0xF50's known readers, so the method sees reads at this displacement. What would show it wrong: a reader through an absolute or computed address, which the scan cannot see.
